purpose: Re-anchor the P004-P018 Stage-0/2 subseries to the parent P3-STAGE-001 / P3-STAGE-003 objective: validate the third-group stage vocabulary by retain/merge/rename/demote/park decisions rather than indefinitely optimizing one Stage-0 classifier.

parent_goal.goal: Learn and qualify stock-stage definitions from history under expert semantic constraints, allowing retain, merge, rename, dimension change or park instead of forcing all labels to pass.

stage_0_parent.reason: P016 and P017 produced 0/9 eligible parent-instability candidates under two distinct scale treatments; P018 shows the parent proposition mixes a clean low-coverage expansion mechanism with a noisy broad-only mechanism. Further Stage-0 optimization would exceed the intended local-learning budget and drift from the third-group portfolio objective.
stage_0_parent.claim: Not disproven as a market concept; not qualified as a primary Stage predicate.

expansion_disorder_child.reason: P018 shows high precision / low FPR but incomplete coverage against the parent instability reference.

broad_reversal_child.reason: Broad-only predictions are the dominant false-positive source in P018. Descriptive geometry may remain, but no current Stage eligibility use is authorized.

stage_2_order.reason: P011 produced a strong orderly-consolidation sub-result while Stage-0 coverage remained the binding joint failure. Stage-2 does not inherit Stage-0 failure, but no official LabelCard/preserved validation is opened here.

stage_1_12.reason: P3-STAGE-003 already retained Stage 12 as downside context and Stage 1 as nested deceleration/stabilization; the accepted Trend Evolution Fact Family is their intended prerequisite.

stage_8_9.reason: P3-STAGE-003 reclassified 8/9 as high-side modifiers; Stage 9 still requires a separately justified activity relation.

superseded_active_recommendation.reason: The recommendation is locally coherent for Stage 0 but conflicts with the higher-level third-group portfolio objective after explicit route review. It remains preserved as historical evidence, not erased.

successor.name: Downside Lifecycle Proposition Pilot
successor.scope: Use accepted Trend Evolution Facts to design a bounded Stage-12 downside-context proposition and a nested Stage-1 deceleration/stabilization condition, with positive evidence and legal coexistence; no primary-stage compression or preserved evaluation in the first milestone.

claim_ceiling: P019 is a portfolio-governance rebaseline. It does not qualify or reject the twelve-state vocabulary as a whole, does not promote Stage 2, and does not prove Stage 0 impossible. It closes active Stage-0 optimization for this sequence and restores the third-group route to the previously retained Stage-1/12 downside lifecycle.
